bio_en: Ghevond Meloyan was a native of Van who studied at the Gevorgian seminary in Etchmiadzin and then taught at the central school in Van. He took part in the revolutionary movement and the fighting in Van, hid with Aram in a pit, and was arrested after Davo's betrayal in 1908, being freed when the constitution was proclaimed. He later taught at the central school of Adapazar and moved to Europe, first Switzerland and then France. He died on 18 December at about ninety, one of the last of the old generation.
